description: This file is a shell script defining tests for the Git version control system, specifically testing diff options like -G and -S with regex and pickaxe features.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timestamp.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of test cases.
